author: Seung Wook
problem: Read a permutation P of 1..N that is not the lexicographically smallest one; print the permutation that comes immediately before it in lexicographic order.
bug_description: The suffix to re-sort is taken as P[r-1:] instead of P[l+1:], so it drops or duplicates elements unless r is exactly l+2.

comments.accurate: Prints the previous permutation: swap the pivot with the largest smaller value to its right, then sort the tail descending
comments.wrong_behavior: Swaps the pivot with the largest smaller value, then sorts in descending order the tail starting just before the swapped position
comments.wrong_location: Tail slicing verified; check the first while loop that walks left to find the pivot
